opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £750 (Adelphi co-sponsored), up to £500 (standard Scheme B), up to £300 (virtual)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members (undergraduate, Master’s, PhD students, postdoctoral scientists within six years of PhD viva) for attending conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at Genetics Society meetings, other genetics-related conferences, and virtual conferences with travel, accommodation, and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK-based course.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to attend short genetics/genomics training courses or collaborative lab visits.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, undertaking UK fieldwork.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel, accommodation, subsistence, and consumables for field-based genetic research projects.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Sponsorship levels up to several thousand pounds; typical major sponsorship £1,000‑£2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members proposing UK‑based genetics-themed meetings.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for organizing ad‑hoc genetics meetings, including travel, accommodation, and a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members proposing public engagement activities related to genetics.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and material costs for public engagement events, both in‑person and virtual.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding

amount.raw: Funding up to £2,000 per year for regular meeting series

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members forming a new Special Interest Group to run regular meetings.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £2,000 annually to sponsor research meetings on specific genetics themes.
